# Analyses for stjernebønnelav *Buellia asterella*

## Required packages

```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
```

## Importing data

```{r}

lav <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data", "Stjernebønnelav_REV_25_26_v2.xlsx"), sheet = "Stjernebønnelav")

```

## Data cleaning

```{r}
lav <- lav %>% 
  rename(
    Year = `År`,
    Size = `Størrelse`,
    Apothecia = `Ant.ap`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    Size = as.numeric(Size),
    Apothecia = as.numeric(Apothecia)
  )
```

## Figures

### Size and number of apothecia

```{r}

fig1 <- ggplot(
  lav,
  aes(x = Size, y = Apothecia,
      colour = factor(Year))
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15, height = 0.15
    )
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", se = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("2025" = "#004F71",
               "2026" = "#E69F00"),
    name = "År"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Thallusstørrelse (mm)",
    y = "Antall apothecier",
    title = ""
  ) +
  theme_classic()

fig1


```

### Individual growth

```{r}
growth <- lav %>%
  select(Individ, Year, Size) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = Size,
    names_prefix = "Size_"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Size_2025),
         !is.na(Size_2026)) %>%
  mutate(
    Growth = Size_2026 - Size_2025
  )

max_size <- max(
  growth$Size_2025,
  growth$Size_2026,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

fig2 <- ggplot(
  growth,
  aes(x = Size_2025, y = Size_2026)
) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1, intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#004F71", size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_size)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_size)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Størrelse i 2025",
    y = "Størrelse i 2026",
    title = "Individuell vekst 2025")

fig2
```
